author: 5kO0
content:
Smoking gun: proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs:957 — `LexUserType::String(_) => "String".to_string()`. Ignores LexString.format entirely. Catch-all on line 985 also returns "String".

Available newtypes in proto-blue-syntax: Did, Handle, Nsid, AtUri, Tid, RecordKey, Datetime, AtIdentifier (handle-or-did union).

Lexicon `format` → Rust mapping to add:
  format: did          → proto_blue_syntax::Did
  format: handle       → proto_blue_syntax::Handle
  format: at-identifier → proto_blue_syntax::AtIdentifier
  format: nsid         → proto_blue_syntax::Nsid
  format: at-uri       → proto_blue_syntax::AtUri
  format: tid          → proto_blue_syntax::Tid
  format: record-key   → proto_blue_syntax::RecordKey
  format: datetime     → proto_blue_syntax::Datetime
  format: cid          → proto_blue_lex_data::Cid (already done for cid-link, extend to format: cid)
  format: language     → newtype TBD (BCP-47 tag) — may defer
  format: uri          → keep as String for now (validation expensive, varies)
  no format            → String

Also for fields with `enum` or `knownValues`: codegen already emits an enum at lines 149–155 — extend to ensure the variant names are properly sanitized (see L5).

Migration risk: this is a breaking change to every generated type. Should land alongside L4 (unions) and L5 (sanitization) as one codegen-output bump, with a CHANGELOG migration note.
